objective: Provide a read-only local audit that identifies the exact frozen model, feature dataset, ALeRCE cache and fold artifacts required by the skipped scientific integration tests without substituting lab artifacts.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: 662 tests passed and 11 skipped; 10 skips depend on missing v0.2 model/feature artifacts.

Original checkout contained a separate lab-smoke artifact with model/schema/calibration/conformal/OOD files. The production artifact path was missing. The lab artifact must not substitute for the frozen production artifact.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: Dropbox artifact search and GitHub Actions artifact inspection
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: No frozen production model or feature dataset was found in accessible Dropbox or retained GitHub Actions artifacts.

expected_improvement: Verify known lab-smoke hashes while keeping that artifact ineligible for production inference
Provide a safe reproducible local audit command
Prevent accidental symlink/copy substitution of the lab model

correctness.before: Missing artifacts were known from prior test skips, but there was no one-command local inventory.
correctness.after: The audit inventories required model, feature, ALeRCE cache, fold and dependent test paths. Its integration_prerequisites_present flag means path presence only; it does not certify artifact integrity or scientific validity.

coverage.before: No consolidated artifact readiness report existed.
coverage.after: The report includes required production model files, feature/config files, raw-cache counts, fold files and explicit dependent-test existence checks.

reliability.before: Lab and production artifacts could be confused by path substitution.
reliability.after: The lab-smoke path is explicitly marked LAB_SMOKE_ONLY_NOT_A_PRODUCTION_SUBSTITUTE and never satisfies production readiness.

measurement.trade_off: The audit requires one local execution because the original WSL filesystem is not accessible through repository tools. It does not upload or modify scientific data.

evidence: A read-only audit script, documentation and deterministic unit tests were added.
The unit tests and actual local WSL audit have not yet run on the final branch head.

Review identified that the initial readiness flag did not require dependent test modules and could be misread as scientific validation; the audit contract is being tightened to report path prerequisites only.

root_causes: The production model artifact is missing from the accessible repository/CI artifact sources.
The lab-smoke artifact exists in the original local checkout but is a separate run and cannot replace the frozen production model.
unresolved: Actual current WSL artifact availability must be confirmed by running the audit script.

findings: Never symlink or copy lab-smoke model weights into the frozen production artifact path.
Keep large scientific artifacts out of Git.
Use exact SHA-256 and immutable artifact manifests for any external artifact source.

open_blockers: Run the corrected artifact audit in the user's WSL checkout and inspect the JSON report.
If the frozen production artifact exists, verify its manifest and run the 10 dependent tests.
If absent, recover it from its original authoritative source; do not rebuild or substitute without a separately approved scientific baseline procedure.

knowledge_carried_forward: Lab-smoke artifact remains separate and is never production-eligible.
